title: More info from Huckstash

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: You got that look in your eyes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You got that look in your eyes.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: You got some burning questions. And you think I got the answers.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You got some burning questions. And you think I got the answers.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Thaddeus left me with more than I wanted to know about the universe... and suffering.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thaddeus left me with more than I wanted to know about the universe... and suffering.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Look, Thaddeus is on a TRIP... In all ways. Exploring reality, inside and outside his own head. He's accelerating down the creases of his own cerebrum.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, Thaddeus is on a TRIP... In all ways. Exploring reality, inside and outside his own head. He's accelerating down the creases of his own cerebrum.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Oh sure. And everywhere else on the way there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh sure. And everywhere else on the way there.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Haha, sure! Thaddeus has neural augments like the ocean has drips.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Haha, sure! Thaddeus has neural augments like the ocean has drips.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: If there's a million ways you can be out of your head, and only one way you can be sober, the chances you are sober right now are a million to one!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If there's a million ways you can be out of your head, and only one way you can be sober, the chances you are sober right now are a million to one!

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: I can't tell you how to get one.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can't tell you how to get one.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Yeah? Well then you don't need me no more.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah? Well then you don't need me no more.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Fuck it, I'll give you the Nav Point. You'd find it eventually anyways. Just... be careful down there. Don't take it too seriously. The ghosts don't truck with folks who laugh as they pass their graves.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fuck it, I'll give you the Nav Point. You'd find it eventually anyways. Just... be careful down there. Don't take it too seriously. The ghosts don't truck with folks who laugh as they pass their graves.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: And if Thaddeus offered me another trip, I wouldn't take it. I seen a lot of things on the rails, but Egress is another level. Literally.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And if Thaddeus offered me another trip, I wouldn't take it. I seen a lot of things on the rails, but Egress is another level. Literally.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Sure, why not? Drugs, but who's sober in this world?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure, why not? Drugs, but who's sober in this world?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What can you tell me about Egress?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What can you tell me about Egress?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What can you tell me about Egress?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What can you tell me about Egress?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What else can you tell me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What else can you tell me?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What else can you tell me?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What else can you tell me?

Friend/Business icon meanings come from gameplay; Enemy's UI label is unconfirmed.
